about: Reference tasks: what customers normally ask. Each runs as one conversation on a private copy of the database. 'reviewer' lists the human decisions, in the order the approval requests arrive ({"approved": true} approves the amount shown; a request beyond the list is rejected). Deterministic check: the refunds written during the run must be exactly 'expected_refunds' (order, product, quantity, amount; amounts computed by hand from data/policies; 'condition' documents the case and lets a test cross-check the amount with the code). Every turn must get an answer. 'expected' describes the answer, for a reader or the judge. Cases found in chat sessions (evaluation/cases_from_chat.json) are added to this set by the loader.
